title: COMPARE CORRELATION LOCALLY AND ACROSS/THROUGH SULCI/GYRI
description: For each vertex, compute the average correlation within a range of geodesic distances that don't cross a sulcus/gyrus, and the correlation to the closest vertex crossing a sulcus/gyrus.  A vertex is considered to cross a sulcus/gyrus if the 3D distance is less than a third of the geodesic distance.  The output file contains the ratio between these correlations, and some additional maps to help explain the ratio.

surface.description: the surface to compute geodesic and 3D distance with

3_d_dist.description: maximum 3D distance to check around each vertex

geo_outer.description: maximum geodesic distance to use for neighboring correlation

geo_inner.description: minimum geodesic distance to use for neighboring correlation

roi.description: select a region of interest that has data

dump_text.description: dump the raw measures used to a text file
